positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer across AI/ML product infrastructure and business-platform systems.  

• Re-architected an AI suggestion-generation pipeline from a synchronous, blocking design into a fully asynchronous, event-driven job system using Meta's Async Job framework — decoupling a high-concurrency upstream ad system from a fragile downstream service, significantly increasing throughput with no latency regression, and eliminating downstream timeout and 5xx errors through load-leveling and throttling. • Built and scaled core infrastructure for an LLM-powered conversational product embedded in advertising entry points, connecting ad interactions to real-time AI conversations across Android, iOS, and web. 
• Owned an end-to-end latency initiative: instrumented a cross-client, cross-service performance pipeline, shipped optimistic-write and response-streaming optimizations, and delivered the team's standing production latency dashboard. • Contributed to a semantic (embedding-based) deduplication system for AI-generated suggestions that replaced a heuristic approach, driving statistically significant gains in engagement and click-through. 
• Led a flagship half-year redesign of the business page-claiming flow — new multi-step UI, rewritten backend write path, and permission/privacy fixes — that eliminated a class of bugs which silently stripped users' existing access, and met its growth goal. • Shipped a full-stack feature (GraphQL APIs, privacy rules, idempotent request/cancel mutations, and frontend views) letting non-admin business users discover and request access to assets. 
• Led the team's privacy-compliance initiative to 100% completion; recognized as a top contributor.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led a team of 8 engineers, promoting a culture of continuous learning and excellence.
Closely partnered with product and design teams, forging strong relationships and open communication
channels to ensure seamless product/feature delivery.
Automated workflows using GitHub Actions, reducing manual intervention and speeding up development
cycles. For example, deployment, production branch cut, post production dependency upgrade, etc.
Leveraged Retool to empower XFN departments with custom dashboards tailored to their needs and to enhance internal dashboards and workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Was the first engineer in the company.
Migrated the code base from vanilla PHP to the Laravel framework.
Developed a language translation framework for international expansion.
Collaborated with the finance team to reform the company payout schedule, reducing and consolidating
month-end payouts.
Built a group subscription flow to provide a SaaS product for clients.
Refactored numerous component logics to utilize the Laravel framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as the tech lead for WhatsApp payments.
Owned the local payment method framework and integrated new local payment methods with DLocal.
Oversaw canvas game payment and transitioned a 7-year-old checkout UI to a new framework.
Developed tokenization solutions with multiple payment gateways (Visa, AMEX, Braintree, Stripe).
Designed a self-serve payment model with 2C2P, enabling small businesses to transact on Facebook.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked in Outlook Team as Software Developer.
Problem solves, Software Architecture, Code Implements, Code Review, Bug Fixes.
